model_choice: Exact binary formulation with auxiliary coverage indicators. Variables: x_j (station selection) and y_i (coverage indicator) for each district i. Total variables: 2*N ≈ 550 for N=275. This fits the CGA GPU annealer backend (few hundred variables). Linear constraints enforce cardinality (sum x = 5) and coverage logic (y_i <= sum x_j for covering j). Objective is linear in y (maximize sum p_i y_i). No quadratic terms needed; model is purely linear QUBO.

districts.meaning: Unique identifier for each district in Taipei

k.meaning: Number of charging stations to select

coverage.meaning: Binary matrix indicating if district j covers district i

derived.how: Compute pairwise distances; set coverage[i,j]=1 if dist(i,j) <= radius
